subject: general
question: Gombe Habba is a famous festival of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Every year, during **Dasara/Navaratri,** enthusiastic persons celebrate **Gombe Habba, or doll festival** in** Karnataka.**
 
• The Festival of Dolls entails gathering a **diverse collection of dolls,** displaying them on a multi-stage platform, and inviting people to view them.
 
• **Wood** is a frequent material for dolls. **Metal, plastic, and clay dolls** can also be used.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
